The bug: `DayWindow.contains()` checks whether the entire shift is inside the window (`self.start <= shift.start and shift.end <= self.end`). This means overnight shifts that cross midnight are excluded entirely. But the report should count only the time worked *within* the day, i.e., compute overlap minutes, not require full inclusion.
